title: Measure and Improve Robustness in NLP Models: A Survey

bias_targets.target: Dataset bias (Spurious correlations and Annotation artifacts)
bias_targets.methodology: Surveying robustness benchmarks (e.g., contrast sets, stress tests) and human/model-in-the-loop techniques used to evaluate if NLP models rely on non-causal, shallow correlations present in the training data.

Reviewing fairness literature and benchmarks (such as WinoGender and WinoBias) used to evaluate and measure gendered stereotypes in tasks like co-reference resolution, occupation classification, and neural machine translation.
Reviewing the evaluation of text generation and summarization models to identify their disproportionate reliance on the position or structural layout of input text.

primary_bias_target: Dataset bias (Spurious correlations and Annotation artifacts)
